# Pro Skill Packs

> Tested skills for the jobs you do every week. Plain-text SKILL.md skills (the open Agent Skills format) that work with any assistant that reads them (Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and others), plus a paste-in prompt version for ChatGPT or any chatbot. Free skills are on GitHub (MIT); paid skills and packs are sold on Gumroad.

## Site structure
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/ : the catalog (search, category chips, price and type filters)
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/for/<category>/ : one page per category with its skills, prompts and guides
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/<skill>/ and https://proskillpacks.github.io/packs/<pack>/ : one page per skill or pack, with a real before and after, limits and install steps
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/free/ : every free skill, installable with `npx skills add proskillpacks/skills`
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/prompts/ : free paste-in prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or any chatbot
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/guides/ : how-to guides, grouped by category, including install guides for each tool
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/study/ : data studies with data files
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/new/ and https://proskillpacks.github.io/feed.xml : what is new
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/faq/, https://proskillpacks.github.io/about/ : questions, licence, refunds, contact
- https://proskillpacks.github.io/catalog/catalog.json : the whole catalog as JSON

## Shopify store owners
- [Agent-Ready Quick Check](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/agent-ready-quick-check/) (Free): Six checks on how AI shopping agents read your store, compared with 99 stores we audited.
- [Agent-Ready Store Audit](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/agent-ready-store-audit/) ($5): A 0 to 100 score for how AI shopping agents read your store, with the top 7 fixes.
- [BFCM Campaign Kit](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/bfcm-campaign-kit/) ($5): Offer maths on your real prices, a dated calendar, 5 emails, 3 SMS and an ops checklist.
- [Chargeback Evidence Checklist](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/chargeback-evidence-checklist/) (Free): Got a chargeback? The evidence to gather for your dispute reason, what you already have, and where to find each piece in Shopify.
- [Chargeback Response Writer](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/chargeback-response-writer/) ($5): A dispute response matched to the reason code. It never invents evidence.
- [Product Description Rewriter](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/product-description-rewriter/) ($5): Clean Shopify HTML descriptions with an SEO title and meta description, for one product or a collection.
- [Product SEO Fixer](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/product-seo-fixer/) ($5): A prioritised fix list with the exact text to paste, for a product, a collection or a product export CSV.
- [Product Title Cleaner](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/product-title-cleaner/) (Free): One consistent title pattern across the catalogue, as an import CSV of changed rows only.
- [Review Reply Drafter](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/review-reply-drafter/) (Free): A reply for every review, matched to its tone, with the risky ones flagged for you.
- [Alt Text Writer](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/shopify-alt-text-writer/) (Free): Alt text for every product image, written while looking at the photo, as an import CSV.
- [Policy Checker](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/shopify-policy-checker/) (Free): Policy gaps and contradictions across refund, shipping, privacy and terms, with fixes to paste.
- [Store Ops Pack](https://proskillpacks.github.io/packs/store-ops-pack/) ($29): Six skills for the Shopify jobs that eat the week, in one download.
- [Support Macro Writer](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/support-macro-writer/) ($5): Ready-to-import replies built from your real shipping and returns policies.

## Freelancers and consultants
- [Late Payment Chaser (UK)](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/late-payment-chaser-uk/) (Free): One unpaid invoice in. The statutory interest and fixed recovery sum worked out with a script, and three reminder emails out. UK business debts only.

## Short-term rental hosts
- [Host Ops Pack](https://proskillpacks.github.io/packs/host-ops-pack/) ($29): Six skills for the listing, review and house-rules jobs of hosts who run their own listings.
- [Listing Rewriter](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/listing-rewriter/) ($5): Three titles under 50 characters and a description within 500, built only from your own facts.

## Marketers and agencies
- [AI Search Readiness Check](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/ai-search-readiness-check/) (Free): Can ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google read a website? A score out of 100 from 8 checks, the evidence and the fixes in order.
- [Search Intent Page Brief](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/search-intent-page-brief/) (Free): Give it a keyword and the pages that rank. Get the search intent, a coverage table, the gaps and an outline. Free, MIT-licensed.

## Developers
- [Accessibility Quick Audit](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/accessibility-quick-audit/) (Free): Give it a page's HTML or components. Get accessibility issues ranked by impact, with the WCAG criterion, the code and a fix. Free, MIT-licensed.
- [PR Description and Review Prep](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/pr-description-and-review-prep/) (Free): Run it on your branch. Get a PR title, summary, risk notes and test plan from the diff, plus the questions a reviewer will ask. Free, MIT-licensed.

## Content and writing
- [Fact-Claim Checker](https://proskillpacks.github.io/skills/fact-claim-checker/) (Free): Paste a draft before you publish. Get the claims that need a source, ranked by risk, what would settle each, and safer wording for the ones you cannot back up.
